facts.title: Favorite Green Salad with Apples, Cranberries and Pepitas
ingredients: 5 ounces (about 5 cups) spring greens salad blend
1 large or 2 small Granny Smith apple(s)
¼ cup pepitas (green pumpkin seeds) or chopped raw pecans
2 ounces chilled goat cheese, crumbled (about ⅓ cup)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
